Messages.Author: Malachy
Messages.Body:
Greets!

For too long I've been searching for a steady solution about the following: Does a bleed ended by Spying Mission burns Protected Resources? I hope we can come to terms at once

Spying Mission

[Action Modifier] Action Modifier

[Obfuscate] Obfuscate

[obf] +1 stealth.
[OBF] Only usable when a bleed would be successful. The bleed burns no pool; it is unsuccessful. Instead, put this card on the acting vampire. The next time this vampire successfully bleeds the same Methuselah, burn this card for +2 bleed.

Protected Resources

Master

[2 Pool]

Master.
Put this card in play. You do not burn more than 2 pool when a minion bleeds you, regardless of the amount of the bleed. Burn this card if a minion you control successfully bleeds.

NC of Hungary

///

Messages.Author: Malachy
Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
Yes you can have multiple spying missions on the one minion against the same Methuselah.

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Both answers are correct.
